claims.text: An exact observation-restricted solver exists iff the task is constant on every observation fiber.
Holding the effective joint observation fixed, network topology can change communication cost without changing identifiability.
For succinct Boolean circuits, BAD-FIBER is NP-complete and exact CIRCUIT-IDENTIFIABLE is coNP-complete.
Finite zero-one Bayes risk is the sum of per-observation-fiber minority mass.

queries: functional dependence verification Boolean circuits NP complete
noninterference hyperproperties observational equivalence program verification
Boolean functional decomposition disjoint support decomposition circuits
Blackwell sufficiency comparison of statistical experiments decision theory

problem: Determine which parts of the observation-factorization framework are established under quotient factorization, sufficient statistics, information ordering, noninterference, functional dependence, and distributed function computation; identify whether the BAD-FIBER NP-completeness result has any residual novelty.
